book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md:
已知 $a, b, c$ 为正实数. 证明:
$$
\frac{a^{2} b^{2}}{a + b} + \frac{b^{2} c^{2}}{b + c} + \frac{c^{2} a^{2}}{c + a} \geqslant abc\left(\frac{a}{a + b} + \frac{b}{b + c} + \frac{c}{c + a}\right).
$$
solution_md:
原式 $\Leftrightarrow \frac{ab}{c(a + b)} + \frac{bc}{a(b + c)} + \frac{ac}{b(c + a)} \geqslant \frac{a}{a + b} + \frac{b}{b + c} + \frac{c}{c + ab} + 3$.
$$
\geqslant (ab + bc + ac)\left(\frac{1}{ac + bc} + \frac{1}{ab + ac} + \frac{1}{bc + ab}\right).
$$
下面进行换元. 令
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x = ab + ac, \\
y = bc + ba, \Rightarrow \left\{\begin{array}{l}
ac = \frac{x + z - y}{2}, \\
ab = \frac{x + y - z}{2}, \Rightarrow ab + bc + ca = \frac{x + y + z}{2},
\end{array}\right. \\
z = ca + cb
\end{array}\right.
$$
$$
bc = \frac{y + z - x}{2}.
$$
由①、②得
$$
\frac{A_{n}}{G_{n}} \leqslant \frac{n + 1}{2 \cdot \sqrt[n]{n!}}.
$$
从而, 命题成立.
